name: Roshutsu Megami-sama
source:
The goddess who presides over exhibitionism. She wears a celestial maiden-style haori with her breasts and crotch fully exposed.

In her own words, “The most wonderful thing in this world is exhibitionism☆”—a belief she staunchly holds. She’s always smiling and has a gentle, dreamy personality, overflowing with compassion. 

She ceaselessly prays for the happiness and greater pleasure of all girls around the world who enjoy exhibitionism, and secretly possesses girls to awaken their latent talent for exhibitionism.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227185/]Getchu[/url]]
